data: Permanent archive plus recent website K, recent dates take priority; factors merged by event date, no double adjustment.
selection: No per-stock best-method selection; all fixed variants reported; historical periods already examined, not a fresh holdout.
execution: Signals on completed close, next market session only, conservative stop-first range but open observed first. End holdings marked with exit cost, not dropped. Limit same-day high never assumed after entry.
capital: Each stock/method starts with one independent cash unit, one position maximum; aggregate is equal initial capital across current universe with no reallocation. It is not a five-position executable portfolio.
limits: Adjusted OHLC, no intraday queue, limit lock, historical tick matching or true tax model
No current financial facts backfilled, no market-cap group based on current shares
Historical MA breadth reconstructed from liquid stocks, not known historical full membership
Calendar derived from market bars; no guarantee missing market sessions are detected
No automatic rule promotion or prediction of exact execution price
